description: Content-addressable cache for expensive Python compute. Skip re-running when cache is warm; run + save when cold. Cache key = hash(asset_key + code_version + partition_key + user key_fn output). Supports local FS and fsspec URIs (s3:// / gs:// / abfs://). Optional TTL freshness. Emits AssetObservation with cached_asset_status=hit|miss tags — searchable in event log. Companion `@cached` decorator wraps existing @dg.asset.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. On cache hit: returns cached DataFrame without calling compute. On miss: runs compute, saves parquet. Metadata: cache_status, cache_key, cache_path, cache_rows.

cache_dir.label: Cache Dir
cache_dir.description: Local path or fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://).

code_version.label: Code Version
code_version.description: Mixed into cache key + set as code_version on asset. Bump to invalidate.

ttl_seconds.label: TTL (seconds)
ttl_seconds.description: Cache expires when file mtime older than this. Omit for no TTL.

key_fn.label: Key Function
key_fn.description: Optional `mod:fn` callable — result stringified + mixed into cache key. Perfect for config-driven invalidation.

name: Cached Asset
